source_cohort: T4 strict paired trajectories from the prior full-field QC gallery
msd_definition: mean of squared 2D endpoint displacement at the matched lag, in um^2

ranking.score: trajectory-time-averaged raw MSD in the nominal 10-s physical-time bin
ranking.role: case selection only; not a new biological endpoint
ranking.why_not_full_10_50s_curve: requiring complete 10-50 s support retained only 1/131 T4 bundles at 2 h and 2/20 at 3.5 h, creating acquisition-duration/cadence selection bias

oligo_livefish_alignment.reason: exposure-time, localization-error and motion-blur calibration are unavailable
